There are two important considerations if a wall retrofit to add insulation and replace siding is pursued: o It would be ideal to do this at the same time as the window replacement to reduce the costs of both and realize time and material efficiency. o This would increase the air tightness of the building and save energy and necessitate a balanced, mechanical building ventilation system that can bring in fresh air (see Section 3.5 Ventilation) so that would need to be done before or at the same time as this retrofit.
